records.title: VTR-Bench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Video Generation
records.reason: VTR-Bench evaluates rendered text quality in video-generation outputs; it is a benchmark for a non-LLM generation modality, not an LLM inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Can Terminal Agents Trust Their Own Verification? Diagnosing and Improving Self-Verification
records.reason: The paper diagnoses terminal-agent self-verification accuracy and recovery; it does not reduce inference resources or serving cost.

records.title: QuantCode Model: Specializing Language Models for Executable Algorithmic Trading Code
records.reason: QuantCode specializes models through continued pretraining and SFT for algorithmic-trading code; the abstract evaluates task quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: GFD-OPD: Guidance-Folded On-Policy Distillation of Diffusion Models Across Scales
records.reason: GFD-OPD distills diffusion models across scales; its target is diffusion image generation rather than LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?
records.reason: LibraryDesignBench evaluates whether agents create reusable software libraries; it reports agent quality and reuse behavior, not an inference/serving efficiency technique.
